units: pixels (x right, y down, full-resolution image coords) and seconds; t = frame / fps

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of house and ground regions < 0.03 px over the whole clip)
camera.perspective: 3D rural scene, camera roughly level looking at a timber-framed house front-on (house front wall nearly fronto-parallel). Ground plane recedes upward; distant horizon/hill line at about y = 1080-1110 behind the fence/cart (true horizon is hidden by trees and buildings; it lies near y ~1080-1100). House front wall verticals are near vertical, so little tilt.
camera.focal_length: unknown - estimate from depth_info + a known size if a question gives them

objects.name: bird
objects.description: the only moving object: a black bird (crow/magpie-like, black body and wings with grey-white sheen on wing feathers and a grey head/beak) flying left -> right in front of the house, head pointing right (+x)
objects.occlusion: unoccluded frames 0-38; foreground leaves of the right-hand tree partly overlap it frames 39-52 (small); frames 53-58 it flies behind the foreground branch and is mostly hidden (head and much of the body hidden, only a wing and tail visible) - positions/sizes there are NOT reliable
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the full bird mask (best proxy for the rig origin); body_x,body_y = centroid of the thick core of the mask (body, wings removed); bbox_cx,bbox_cy = bbox centre
objects.image_path: enters already in view at (355,780) at frame 0, flies nearly horizontally to the right; mask centroid x increases ~21.4 px/frame on average (frames 0-52), y oscillates 760-820 with the wingbeat (no net climb/descent: y 780 -> 790 over 0-52); at frame 58 at about (1430,838) behind leaves
objects.apparent_size: bbox width (tip-to-tail / wingtip extent along x) ~150-170 px, slow increase ~0.3 px/frame (155 median in frames 0-20, 167 in 40-52) -> at most ~10% closer at the end, i.e. roughly constant depth; bbox height 56 (wings level) to 134 px (wings spread up/down); main-axis length 121-192 px
objects.wingbeat: bbox_h maxima (wings spread vertically) at frames 5-6, 14, 23-24, 31-32, 40-41, 49; wings-level minima at frames 1, 19, 36, 44 -> period ~8.7 frames (~0.38 s)
